label: EPI lift station — EdgePoint Industrial (MQTT)
model: EdgePoint Industrial lift (Nexus Cloud register map)
notes: Track A — Azure Function (deploy/azure/nexcomm-sb-mqtt-function) or nexcomm-sb-mqtt-bridge publishes to mqtts://mqtt.peaklogic.io:8883 (lab: mqtt://127.0.0.1:1883). Nexcomm serials may arrive as xxxx-xxxxxx; use normalized serialNum without hyphens (e.g. 40a3-6bce47f3 → 40a36bce47f3). Subscribe /devices/<serial>/messages/events/. Default serial 40a36bce47f3 = Nexus Cloud Master Lift Station. Set liftProfile=liftpoint_light and serialNum=862406071948166 for LiftPoint Light. Sample: st/fixtures/edgepoint-lift-station-sample.json.
